# STAR Methods interoperability profile

This profile provides an independently written mapping from the package's
neutral core fields to a three-column STAR Methods-style layout, for
interoperability only.

- No Cell Press or STAR Methods workbook, template, logo, or branded
  instructional text is bundled with this package.
- The mapping and validation rules were written from publicly documented STAR
  Methods field requirements.
- To produce a file in an official STAR template, obtain the template yourself
  and pass it to the writer via the `template` argument.
- No affiliation with or endorsement by Cell Press is implied.
